res.summary:
I read every file in web/src (App.tsx 281 lines, RunView.tsx 465, Blink.tsx 118, PaperTab.tsx 105, api.ts 324, main.tsx, styles.css 320) plus web/index.html, vite.config.ts and the server routes. I did not edit anything.

The identity is already coherent: lightbox grey chrome, graphite ink, a dark stage, cyan/magenta A/B marks, Atkinson plus Newsreader, and calm, non-accusatory copy. The basic three-pane workspace (rail, stage, inspector) is the right structure. Six main gaps keep the app from best-in-class:

1. **The figure stage has no zoom or pan.** For an image-forensics tool, that is the biggest gap compared with Preview/Photos, Figma, ImageTwin and Proofig.
2. **The Blink comparator is squeezed into the light 420px inspector.** Frames are capped at 360px tall (styles.css:238), and below 1180px it sits in a 46vh bottom strip. The app's signature feature never gets the dark stage.
3. **Panel outlines are white at 18% opacity** (styles.css:204-207). They and the "picked" state cannot be seen on the white backgrounds most figures have, so manual comparison is close to undiscoverable.
4. **Keyboard use is almost nil.** The only shortcut is Space inside Blink, and it works only while the Blink wrapper itself has focus. There is no j/k navigation, no command palette and no help overlay. Panels are `<g onClick>` elements (RunView.tsx:281), so they cannot be reached from the keyboard. The tabs use role="tablist" with no tabpanel and no arrow-key handling.
5. **There is no triage workflow.** You cannot mark a finding as reviewed, dismissed or a concern; tools like Proofig and ImageTwin support this. Navigation and selection are not in the URL, so the back button and deep links do not work. Your edits to the draft comment are lost when you switch tabs (RunView.tsx:383-387).
6. **State handling and accessibility have real defects:**
   - errors are shown with alert() and confirm()
   - unhandled promise rejections (demo button App.tsx:139, AI polling RunView.tsx:57, settings load App.tsx:217, clipboard RunView.tsx:394)
   - NaN and "undefined s" can render in the metadata (RunView.tsx:98, 323-325)
   - white text on dark-mode severity pills is 1.9-2.7:1 contrast (styles.css:132-134)
   - the cyan focus ring is 2.9:1 on the light panel, below the 3:1 non-text minimum
   - the white-on-cyan A tag is 3.07:1
   - false positives are dimmed to opacity .55
   - nothing announces progress or saves to screen readers (no aria-live)
   - theme follows the OS only, with no override
   - fonts load from Google even though the page says "Uploaded files stay on this computer" (index.html:7-9)

The redesign spec below keeps the identity and covers: tokens and theming, routing, Home (with a staged progress view), a run workspace with resizable and collapsible panes, a zoomable canvas with visible panel outlines and a filmstrip, a full-stage Blink comparator with an onion mode, adjustable difference gain and synced zoom, finding triage, a command palette, a complete keyboard map, every empty, loading and error state, accessibility rules, responsive breakpoints, Settings, the Draft tab, and copy rules.

Server context, so nothing in the spec assumes an endpoint that does not exist:
- `/api/health` exists but the web app never calls it.
- The server's view modes include "edges", which the web app does not expose (forensics.py:112 compared with RunView.tsx:6-12).
- The difference image's gain is fixed at ×3 on the server (evidence.py:87).
- There is no endpoint for cancelling a job or saving triage, so the spec stores triage in localStorage and treats a server endpoint as optional.

issues.problem: The figure stage has no zoom, pan, loupe or 100% view. The figure is always fitted to the container, so cloned patches, splice seams and painted regions cannot be examined at pixel level. This is the core job of an image-integrity tool (Preview, Photos, Figma, ImageTwin and Proofig all offer it).
issues.change: Replace FigureCanvas with a zoomable viewport: CSS transform matrix on .canvas-inner; zoom 10%-1600% with Ctrl/Cmd+wheel and trackpad pinch; plain wheel/trackpad scrolls (pans); drag pans; holding Space plus drag pans; double-click zooms 2x at the pointer; '0' fits, '1' shows 100%, '+' and '-' step zoom; a zoom % readout and Fit/100% buttons in the stage bar. Set image-rendering: pixelated at 200% and above. The SVG overlay shares the transform.

issues.problem: The signature Blink comparator renders inside the light 420px inspector, with frames capped at max-height 360px. Below 1180px wide the inspector becomes a 46vh bottom strip. The most important view is the smallest thing on screen and never uses the dark stage.
issues.change: Add a 'Compare' stage mode. When a pair finding (image.duplicate with 2 panels, image.duplicate_chart) or a manual 2-panel pick is active, the stage shows the full-size Blink comparator (dark, fills the stage, zoom synced across A and B). The inspector shows a 160px thumbnail preview with 'Show in stage' (shortcut Enter). The figure view stays one key away (F toggles Figure/Compare). See the redesign spec, Compare stage.

issues.problem: Panel outlines are white at 18% opacity (hover: white 70%; picked: white dashed). Most figures have white backgrounds, so outlines, hover and the picked state are invisible there. Users cannot see that panels are clickable or which ones they picked, which hides manual comparison.
issues.change: Use a two-stroke outline that shows on any background: an outer 3px rgba(0,0,0,.45) stroke under an inner 1px rgba(255,255,255,.9) stroke, both vector-effect: non-scaling-stroke. Hover: inner stroke var(--ink-on-stage) plus fill rgba(18,160,196,.08). Picked A: solid 2px cyan with a dark halo and a corner tag 'A'. Picked B: magenta with tag 'B'. Add an outline toggle (key O) with three states: Off, On hover only, Always (default).

issues.problem: Keyboard support is almost absent. Panels are mouse-only <g onClick> elements. There is no next/previous finding, no figure navigation and no shortcut help. Space flips Blink only while the outer Blink div has focus; clicking a mode button moves focus there, so Space then re-activates the button instead of flipping. The tabs declare role=tablist with no tabpanel, no aria-controls and no arrow-key handling. The Blink mode buttons misuse role=tab.
issues.change: Add a single global keyboard handler, ignored while focus is in input, textarea or select (full map in the spec). Panels: each <g> gets role='button', tabIndex 0, aria-label 'Panel 3B, pick for comparison', aria-pressed, and handles Enter/Space. Also add a 'Compare panels…' combobox in the stage bar. Tabs: the WAI-ARIA tabs pattern with roving tabindex, Left/Right/Home/End keys, and role=tabpanel with aria-labelledby. Blink modes become a radiogroup (segmented control) and Blink keys work stage-wide.

issues.problem: Only the run id is in the URL. The selected finding, figure, tab, view mode and manual comparison are not, so the back button leaves the run, links cannot point to 'Fig 3 B vs E', and a reload loses your place.
issues.change: Use hash routes #/run/:id, #/run/:id/f/:findingId, #/run/:id/fig/:figId and #/run/:id/cmp/:panelA/:panelB, with query parameters ?tab=findings|figures|paper|draft&view=original|levels|reveal|noise|edges|false. Selecting a finding uses replaceState and opening a comparison uses pushState. Add a 'Copy link' action (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+C) on the inspector.

issues.problem: There is no triage state. Users cannot mark findings as reviewed, a concern, or dismissed, unlike Proofig, ImageTwin and the Linear triage pattern. They also cannot see review progress or filter by it. The AI verdict is the only judgement shown.
issues.change: Add per-finding review states: Unreviewed (default), Concern, Needs raw data, Dismissed. Store them in localStorage key `pi.review.<runId>` as {[findingId]: {state, note, at}}, and sync via PUT /api/runs/{id}/review if one is added later. Shortcuts: C concern, R needs raw data, X dismiss, U unreviewed. Show a review progress meter '12 of 31 reviewed' in the rail header, add a 'Review' filter chip group, and include Concern and Needs-raw-data findings in the Draft by default.

issues.problem: Draft edits live in component state. Switching to another tab unmounts ReportTab and loses the edits. The useEffect on report.ai_review re-fetches and silently overwrites edits. The fetch has no loading or error state, and navigator.clipboard.writeText has no catch.
issues.change: Persist the draft in localStorage `pi.draft.<runId>` with a 500ms debounce. When the generated text changes and a saved edit exists, show an inline notice: 'A new draft is available from the AI review. [Replace my edits] [Keep mine]'. Add a skeleton while loading, an error message with Retry, and a word count. Copy shows a toast 'Draft copied' and falls back to selecting the text if the clipboard API rejects.

issues.problem: There are unhandled promise rejections and blocking native dialogs. The demo button has no try/catch, so it fails silently when the engine is down. AI polling has no try/catch, so one failed fetch stops polling forever while the button keeps showing a stage. Investigation errors use alert(). Delete uses confirm(), has no undo, and its error is unhandled. If api.settings() fails, the dialog stays on 'Loading…' with no way out except Esc.
issues.change: Wrap every API call. Add a toast region (aria-live='polite', bottom-left, 4s, pausable on hover or focus) for transient results, and inline errors with Retry for failed loads. Delete becomes optimistic, with a toast 'Scan deleted. [Undo]' (6s), and the API call runs only when the toast expires. AI polling retries 3 times with backoff (0.9s, 2s, 5s), then shows a banner with Retry. The settings dialog shows its own error with Retry and Close.

issues.where: web/src/styles.css:132-134 (.dot) with dark tokens 24-40; Blink tag styles.css:241
issues.problem: Contrast failures. White text on the dark-mode severity pills: medium #e3b34c 1.94:1, high #f59a64 2.17:1, low #9fb0c3 2.22:1, critical #f2786d 2.73:1. The white-on-cyan Blink A tag is 3.07:1 at 13px.
issues.change: Add on-colour tokens (--on-critical and so on) set to #111418 in dark mode and #fff in light mode. Blink A tag: background #0b7f9c (4.64:1 with white) or ink #1d232b on #12a0c4 (5.16:1); keep #d3336e with white (4.7:1) for B. Check every pair against WCAG 4.5:1 for text and 3:1 for UI.

issues.problem: The focus ring is #12a0c4 at 2.91:1 against the light panel #f8f9fb, below the 3:1 non-text minimum. On the dark stage, the ring next to cyan finding marks is ambiguous.
issues.change: Define --focus: #0b7f9c in light mode and #5cc8e4 in dark mode. Ring: outline 2px solid var(--focus), outline-offset 2px, plus box-shadow 0 0 0 4px var(--focus-halo) (paper colour) so it reads on both backgrounds. On the stage use outline 2px solid #fff with a 4px rgba(0,0,0,.6) halo, so the focus ring is never confused with cyan marks.

issues.problem: Selecting a finding whose figure id is not in report.figures leaves figId unchanged. The stage keeps showing an unrelated figure with no marks while the inspector describes something else.
issues.change: If the location's figure is not in report.figures, set figId to null and show the 'not about a figure' stage state, naming the location (page, file, sheet). Only keep the current figure when the finding has no location at all, and say so in the stage: 'This finding has no location.'

issues.problem: Finding marks are drawn only for locations that have both a figure and a panel (filter at line 261). A location with a figure-level box but no panel is silently not drawn.
issues.change: Draw figure-level boxes directly when l.panel is missing and l.box is present. Label each mark with an HTML tag (A, B, then 1, 2, 3 beyond two) in the mark's colour, placed at the top-left outside corner.

issues.problem: Panel labels are SVG text sized at 18 figure-pixels, so they scale with the figure: unreadable on 3000px figures, oversized on 400px ones, and wrong again once zoom is added.
issues.change: Render panel labels as absolutely positioned HTML chips in a layer above the SVG. Compute positions from the transform, use a fixed 11px/600 font, a pill with background rgba(15,18,21,.72) and white text, and hide them below 40% zoom when there are more than 24 panels.

issues.problem: The measurements assume fields exist: Number(undefined).toFixed(2) renders 'NaN', Math.round(NaN) renders 'NaN%', and String(undefined) renders 'undefined'. The labels ('Texture match', 'Keypoints') are not explained or anchored to thresholds.
issues.change: Add a formatter that returns '–' for non-finite values. Show each measurement as a row with label, value and a hint popover (? icon, also on focus), e.g. 'Texture match 0.83: copies usually score above 0.5, unrelated images near 0'. Add a mini bar for texture match, with the 0.5 threshold tick in --ink-2.

issues.problem: Metadata line errors: a stray '. ' sits at column 0 on line 97. When timings.total is undefined it renders ', s'. Without a DOI, report.paper.source appears in both h1 and p. The whole line is a single ellipsised string, so most of it is hidden.
issues.change: Build the metadata as an array of parts, filter out empty ones, and join with a ' · ' separator. Split it into a breadcrumb row and a chip row: [Retracted] Journal · 2019 · Smith et al. · doi:… then 5 figures · 42 panels · 3 tables · 2 supplementary files · 38 s. Each chip has a title tooltip.

issues.problem: The score is a bare ring with a number and the verdict prefix. The full verdict is only in title=, it does not say the score covers integrity signals only, and there is no accessible name. The tone thresholds are duplicated in App.tsx:162.
issues.change: Make Score a button that opens a popover: 'Integrity score 64 of 100. High concern. Set by integrity signals only; quality notes are not counted.' The popover also shows a breakdown by severity and, if AI-adjusted, 'Before AI review: 71'. Add aria-label with the same text. Move the tone function into api.ts and share it.

issues.problem: Progress is minimal. Scan progress appears inside the drop zone, even for DOI jobs, and shows only a stage string and a bar: no step list, no elapsed time, no aria-live. During an AI run the primary button's label becomes the stage text, so the button width jumps and nothing explains it.
issues.change: Home: a dedicated progress card replaces the input area while running (spec: Home, Running state) with stepper, elapsed time, determinate bar and aria-live='polite'. Run view: the AI button becomes a fixed-width (196px) 'Investigating…' button with a spinner. A 2px progress line at the bottom of the top bar shows the current stage in a tooltip, and a status chip appears next to the score.

issues.problem: Engine-offline handling. The error appears, but the DOI form, drop zone and demo stay enabled and every action then fails. /api/health exists (server.py:78) but is never used. The drop zone's onKeyDown ignores busy, so it opens the file picker during a scan (line 122). The file input has no accept list.
issues.change: On mount, poll /api/health every 5s until it succeeds. While offline, show the Offline state (spec), disable the actions, and offer a 'Copy command' button for 'paperinspector serve'. Guard onKeyDown with !busy. Set accept='.pdf,.png,.jpg,.jpeg,.tif,.tiff,.bmp,.webp,.xlsx,.xls,.csv,.docx,.zip'.

issues.problem: The two scan options ('Several PDFs are separate papers…', 'Check references online for uploads') sit at the same visual level as 'Try the demo paper'. They are long, wrap awkwardly, and apply only to uploads, not to the DOI path.
issues.change: Move them into an 'Upload options' disclosure under the drop zone with two switches: 'Compare as separate papers' (hint: 'Use when you drop 2+ PDFs from different papers') and 'Look up references online' (hint: 'DOI scans always do this'). The demo becomes a text link: 'No paper handy? Try the demo →'.

issues.problem: Recent scans is a flat list with no search, sort or empty state, and no AI or review status. Date strings are raw ISO. The colour dot has no meaning for screen readers. Delete is a second, full-width-looking button on each row.
issues.change: Rebuild it as a table-like list (spec: Home, Recent scans): search, sort (Newest / Highest score), relative dates ('2 h ago', with absolute time in title), score pill with aria-label, review progress, and a kebab menu (Open, Copy link, Download report, Delete). Use the [role=grid] pattern with arrow keys.

issues.problem: Figures live in a separate rail tab, so you lose the findings list when browsing figures. Thumbnails are 72×56. There is no prev/next figure control on the stage.
issues.change: Add a filmstrip at the bottom of the stage: 64px tall, horizontal scroll, thumbnails 88×56 with a label and a finding-count badge, the current figure outlined in white. Prev/next with , and . keys and chevron buttons in the stage bar, and a figure picker dropdown. Keep the Figures tab as a list view with larger 120×80 thumbnails and a filter 'Only figures with findings'.

issues.problem: The server supports an 'edges' view mode that the web app does not expose. Switching view modes swaps the img src with no loading indicator, so the old image stays until the new one decodes. Mode names are unexplained ('Reveal', 'Noise').
issues.change: Add 'Edges'. Preload the next view and cross-fade (0ms if reduced motion), showing a small spinner in the segmented button while it loads. Give each mode a tooltip, e.g. 'Levels: stretches contrast to show faint backgrounds'. Shortcuts 1-6.

issues.problem: Blink controls. The speed slider is inverted (value 1650-rate) with no unit or readout and no aria-valuetext. Swipe has no keyboard control, no visible handle and no pointer capture (dragging outside the frame loses it). Difference gain is fixed at ×3 on the server (evidence.py:87). There is no onion-skin opacity mode, no zoom, no loupe.
issues.change: Implement the controls in the Compare stage spec: rate in Hz (1-8, default 2) with an 'n Hz' readout and aria-valuetext; a swipe handle as role=slider (Left/Right 1%, Shift 10%) with setPointerCapture; client-side difference using mix-blend-mode: difference with a gain slider ×1-×16 (filter: brightness(gain) on an isolated wrapper); an Onion mode with an opacity slider; zoom synced across all modes.

issues.problem: The AI summary and the AI-only observations sit in the findings rail, mixed with detector output and styled the same. AI-only observations are non-interactive divs that look like the buttons around them.
issues.change: Move the AI review into its own collapsible 'AI investigator' card pinned at the top of the rail (model, steps, time, summary clamped to 4 lines with 'Read more'). Show AI-only observations as a separate group, 'Seen by the AI only', with a dashed left bar and an 'AI' glyph; they are selectable and open in the inspector with a 'Not verified by a detector' notice.

issues.problem: Findings the AI marked as false positives are dimmed to opacity .55, which pushes their text below 4.5:1 and makes them look disabled.
issues.change: Keep the text at full contrast. Show the AI false-positive verdict with a strikethrough-free 'AI: false positive' pill (--ok tone) and move those findings to the end of their severity group. Add a 'Hide AI-dismissed' filter.

issues.problem: Dark mode follows the OS only, with no in-app override. The logo hard-codes #fff and #1d232b, so it is a glaring white tile in dark mode. index.html has no meta theme-color, color-scheme or description.
issues.change: Add a theme setting (System / Light / Dark) stored in localStorage `pi.theme` and applied as data-theme on <html> before first paint by an inline script. Tokenise the logo colours. Add <meta name='color-scheme' content='light dark'>, theme-color metas for each scheme (#f8f9fb / #1b2026) and a meta description.

issues.problem: Fonts load from Google Fonts while the page promises 'Uploaded files stay on this computer'. Every page load calls a third party, and the app has no fonts offline.
issues.change: Self-host Atkinson Hyperlegible Next (400/500/700) and Newsreader (opsz 6-72, 400/600) as woff2 in web/public/fonts with @font-face, font-display: swap, and size-adjust fallbacks to limit layout shift. Remove the preconnects.

issues.problem: Settings has several problems. Labels wrap whole rows containing several inputs and buttons (lines 249-255, 269-273), which is invalid labelling, and clicking the label text focuses the input. Autosave fires on blur with a transient 'Saved' that is not announced. Changing provider wipes the model silently. There is no test-connection action and no appearance or shortcuts section.
issues.change: Rebuild Settings as a sheet with left-side sections (AI investigator, Scholarly data, Appearance, Keyboard) as described in the spec. Each label is bound to one input via htmlFor. Saves are announced through aria-live ('Saved'). Changing provider shows a 'Model reset to <default>' line. Optionally a 'Test connection' button calls a new endpoint if one is added; otherwise omit it.

issues.problem: Filtering is limited: there is no text search, no severity or kind filter, and no sort. The category chips count excludes notes, but the list includes notes once 'Show notes' is ticked, so the counts disagree. The 'Show N notes' checkbox sits at the bottom of a long list.
issues.change: Add a filter bar: a search input ('/' to focus; matches title, check name, detail and location), a Kind segmented control (All / Integrity / Quality), category chips with counts that follow the current filters, a Review filter, and an overflow menu with 'Show notes (N)', 'Hide AI-dismissed' and 'Sort: Severity / Location / Confidence'. Show 'Clear filters' whenever any filter is active.

issues.problem: The inspector is one flat stack with no section headings. Evidence images use the filename as alt text (line 331), and the GIF is shown only for non-pair findings. Supplement links download without saying so. Quotes are not highlighted or linked to their page. There are no actions (triage, copy, add to draft, open in report).
issues.change: Restructure into: a header (severity label, check, confidence meter), the title, an action bar, then the sections 'What we found', 'Comparison', 'Measurements', 'Evidence', 'Where', 'AI opinion' and 'Raw data'. Each section has an h3 and collapses, with collapse state remembered. Evidence images get meaningful alt text and open full-screen on click. Link quotes to the source PDF at that page (#page=N).

issues.problem: The AI error banner cannot be dismissed, has no Retry or Settings button, and has no role=alert.
issues.change: Use a banner component with role='alert', an icon, the message, and the actions [Open settings] [Retry] [×].

issues.problem: Responsive layout. At 1180px and below the inspector becomes a bottom strip that cramps both the stage and the inspector. At 760px and below the rail is capped at 50vh with nested scrolling, and the stage is 60vh with no touch zoom. Pane widths are fixed: no resizing or collapsing.
issues.change: Use the breakpoints in the spec: ≥1280px three panes with resizable rail (260-440) and inspector (340-560), with collapse buttons and the [ and ] keys; 960-1279px rail plus stage, with the inspector as a 420px overlay drawer that opens when a finding is selected; below 960px a single column with a sticky bottom tab bar (Findings · Image · Details) and touch pinch zoom on the stage. Store pane widths in localStorage.

issues.problem: Landmarks and headings. Home has no <main>, and the run view uses <main> for the stage but an unlabeled <section> for the inspector. There is no skip link. The h2/h3 order in the rail is inconsistent (kind-h is an h2, sev-h an h3, and the AI summary an h3 above both).
issues.change: Home: <header>, <main id='main'> and <footer>. Run view: <header role=banner>, <nav aria-label='Findings'> for the rail, <main aria-label='Image stage'> and <aside aria-label='Finding details'>. Add a skip link 'Skip to findings'. Rail headings: h2 Integrity signals / Quality notes, then h3 for severity groups.

issues.problem: There is no spacing, type or elevation scale: font sizes are ad hoc (12/13/14/15/16/17/18/19/20/22px) and padding values arbitrary (7px 14px, 3px 9px, 2px 9px). Controls are 26-30px tall, below a comfortable target size. There are no motion tokens.
issues.change: Adopt the token scale in the spec: 4px spacing grid; type 12/13/14/16/20/24/32/48; control heights 28 (compact, stage), 32 (default), 40 (hero); radii 4/6/10/14; two elevations; motion 120ms/200ms with a cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) ease, all set to 0 under prefers-reduced-motion.

issues.problem: The figure caption is crammed into the stage-hint paragraph at 85% opacity. Long legends push the canvas up, and the hint text competes with the caption.
issues.change: Put the caption in a collapsible 'Legend' drawer above the filmstrip (2-line clamp, 'Show full legend' expands to 40% of stage height, toggle with L). Move hints into the stage bar's right edge as a single muted line that disappears after first use (localStorage pi.hint.compare).

issues.problem: The numbers in the Paper tab are plain dt/dd pairs with no comparison: is 18% self-citation high? Problem values are not linked to their findings. 'Could not be found' combines two different counts.
issues.change: Show each statistic with a status dot (ok/watch/flag), using the same thresholds as the engine's findings. A flagged value links to its finding ('View finding →'). Show 'Unmatched' and 'Broken DOIs' separately, and render the top cited authors as a small bar list.

issues.problem: prefers-reduced-motion is read once at render with matchMedia(...).matches, without subscribing to changes. It also starts paused but still shows 'Pause'/'Play' with no explanation.
issues.change: Add a useReducedMotion() hook with a change listener. When reduced motion is on, start in Swipe mode and show the note 'Auto-blink is off because reduced motion is on. Press Space to flip by hand.'

res.redesign_spec:
PAPER INSPECTOR WEB: REDESIGN SPEC (keeps the identity: lightbox grey chrome, graphite ink, dark image stage, cyan A / magenta B, Atkinson Hyperlegible Next + Newsreader. The Blink comparator is the hero feature.)

====================================================================
0. TOKENS (styles/tokens.css; replaces styles.css:1-40)
====================================================================
Theme selection: an inline script in index.html <head> reads localStorage 'pi.theme' (system|light|dark) and sets <html data-theme="light|dark"> before first paint. CSS: :root (light), :root[data-theme=dark], and @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { :root:not([data-theme=light]) {...} }.

Colour, light / dark:
--paper #eef1f4 / #15191e (app background, lightbox)
--panel #f8f9fb / #1b2026 (rail, inspector, top bar)
--raised #ffffff / #222830 (cards, popovers, menus)
--ink #1d232b / #e4e8ed
--ink-2 #4a5562 / #a3adb8 (secondary text, ≥4.5:1 on paper and panel)
--ink-3 #6b7785 / #8b97a5 (tertiary; only ≥14px or non-essential text)
--line #d5dbe2 / #2d343c ; --line-strong #b8c1cb / #3a434d
--stage #24282d / #0f1215 ; --stage-2 #2d3238 / #171b1f (stage toolbars) ; --stage-ink #cfd5dc / #b8c0c9 ; --stage-line #3a4048 / #2a3036
--mark-a #12a0c4 (both themes; strokes only) ; --mark-a-strong #0b7f9c (A tag background, white text 4.64:1)
--mark-b #d3336e (both themes; B tag background, white text 4.7:1)
--focus #0b7f9c / #5cc8e4 ; --focus-halo var(--paper)
--critical #b42318 / #f2786d ; --high #c4320a / #f59a64 ; --medium #a15c07 / #e3b34c ; --low #475467 / #9fb0c3 ; --info #6b7785 / #8b97a5 ; --ok #157f3b / #5cc98a
--on-sev #ffffff / #111418 (text on any solid severity fill)
--sev-tint-<x>: color-mix(in srgb, var(--<x>) 12%, var(--panel))
Typography: --sans Atkinson Hyperlegible Next; --serif Newsreader; --mono ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo. Sizes: 12 (meta, badges), 13 (secondary UI), 14 (body UI), 16 (reading body), 20 (pane titles, serif 600), 24 (dialog titles, serif 600), 32 (run title on mobile), clamp(40px, 5vw, 60px) (home h1, serif 600, -0.015em). Line-height 1.45 for UI and 1.55 for prose; tabular-nums globally.
Space: 4px grid (4, 8, 12, 16, 20, 24, 32, 48, 64). Radii: --r-xs 4, --r-s 6, --r-m 10, --r-l 14. Control heights: 28 compact (stage toolbar, chips), 32 default, 40 hero input and buttons. Minimum hit area 28×28 (24 is the WCAG floor).
Elevation: --shadow-1 0 1px 2px rgba(16,24,40,.06), 0 1px 1px rgba(16,24,40,.04); --shadow-2 0 8px 24px rgba(16,24,40,.14), 0 2px 6px rgba(16,24,40,.08); in dark mode use 0 0 0 1px var(--line) plus deeper shadows.
Motion: --dur-1 120ms, --dur-2 200ms, --ease cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1). Under @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce), set all transitions and animations to 0ms, except Blink frame changes, which are already discrete.
Focus: :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--focus-halo); }. Inside .stage: outline 2px solid #fff plus box-shadow 0 0 0 4px rgba(0,0,0,.6).
Fonts: self-host woff2 in /public/fonts; remove Google Fonts. Add <meta name="color-scheme" content="light dark">, <meta name="theme-color" media="(prefers-color-scheme: light)" content="#f8f9fb">, the same for dark with #1b2026, and <meta name="description" content="Screen a scientific paper for image, data, statistics and reference problems.">.

Shared components (web/src/ui/): Button (variants primary | secondary | ghost | danger; sizes s28/m32/l40; optional leading icon; loading spinner keeps the width), IconButton (aria-label required, tooltip on hover/focus after 500ms), Segmented (role=radiogroup, arrow keys), Tabs (WAI-ARIA tabs, roving tabindex), Chip (toggle, aria-pressed, count), Menu (button + role=menu, arrow/Home/End/typeahead, Esc), Popover, Tooltip, Toast region (aria-live=polite, bottom-left 16px, stacks of up to 3, 4s; 6s if it has an action; pauses on hover/focus), Banner (info | warn | error, role=alert for errors, actions and a dismiss button), Skeleton (shimmer disabled under reduced motion), Kbd (key cap), SeverityBadge (text label plus glyph, never colour alone: critical ◆, high ▲, medium ●, low ○, note ·), ScorePill, Meter.

====================================================================
1. ROUTING AND STATE
====================================================================
Hash routes:
#/ → Home
#/run/:id → Run, auto-selects the first non-note integrity finding (else the first quality finding, else the first figure)
#/run/:id/f/:findingId
#/run/:id/fig/:figId
#/run/:id/cmp/:panelA/:panelB (manual comparison; panel ids are URI-encoded)
Query: ?tab=findings|figures|paper|draft &view=original|levels|reveal|noise|edges|false &mode=figure|compare
Selecting a finding or figure uses history.replaceState; opening a comparison or changing tab uses pushState. The back button walks comparisons and tabs, then leaves the run.
localStorage keys (wrap every access in try/catch): pi.theme, pi.panes ({rail:number, insp:number, railOpen, inspOpen}), pi.review.<runId>, pi.draft.<runId>, pi.blink ({mode, hz, gain}), pi.outlines (off|hover|always), pi.hints.<name>.

====================================================================
2. HOME (#/)
====================================================================
Layout: max-width 1200px, 24px gutters (16px below 760px). The header is 56px tall: logo + 'Paper Inspector' (16px, 700) on the left; on the right an engine status dot ('Engine ready v0.x' in ink-2 at 13px; amber 'Connecting…'; red 'Engine offline'), IconButton Theme (sun/moon, cycles System → Light → Dark, aria-label 'Theme: System'), and Button 'Settings' (secondary, s32).
Hero (grid 1.05fr / .95fr, gap 56px; one column below 960px):
 Left column:
 - h1 (serif): 'Paste a DOI. Get the paper inspected.'
 - Lede (16px/1.55, ink-2, max 56ch): keep the current copy.
 - DOI field (height 48, radius 10, 1.5px border --line-strong, focus border --focus): leading icon (magnifier), input with placeholder '10.1371/journal.pbio.1002106 or a doi.org link', trailing primary Button 'Inspect' (l40) with a Kbd '↵' hint inside at ≥960px. Pasting a URL normalises it inline and shows a helper line '→ 10.1371/…' under the field. Invalid input on submit shows an inline error under the field: 'That doesn't look like a DOI. Try something like 10.1038/nature12373.' The field is labelled 'DOI or article link' (visually hidden) and has aria-describedby on the helper and error lines. '/' or Cmd/Ctrl+L focuses it.
 - Divider 'or' (13px, ink-3, line rules on both sides).
 - Drop zone (min-height 112, dashed 1.5px --line-strong, radius 10, panel background): icon (document stack) + 'Drop the PDF here, with its supplementary files' (16px/600) + 'PDF, images, spreadsheets, Word files and zips. Paywalled papers: add the PDF yourself.' (14px, ink-2) + Button 'Choose files…' (secondary s32). While dragging anywhere over the window, a full-window overlay (paper at 88% alpha, 2px dashed --mark-a inset 16px) reads 'Drop to inspect'. The drop zone itself is role=button with aria-label 'Choose files to inspect'. File input accept='.pdf,.png,.jpg,.jpeg,.tif,.tiff,.bmp,.webp,.xlsx,.xls,.csv,.docx,.zip'.
 - After files are dropped and before the scan starts (new staged state): a file list card showing name, kind badge (Paper / Supplement / Image) and size. The first PDF is marked 'Paper'; any file can be promoted with a 'Make this the paper' menu item; × removes a file. 'Upload options' disclosure (closed by default) holds two switches: 'Compare as separate papers' (enabled only with 2+ PDFs; hint 'Each PDF is treated as its own paper and images are matched across them') and 'Look up references online' (hint 'Sends reference titles to Crossref and OpenAlex. DOI scans always do this.'). Buttons: primary 'Inspect 4 files' and ghost 'Clear'.
 - Under the drop zone, a text link: 'No paper handy? Try the demo →'.
 - Privacy line (13px, ink-2) with a lock icon: keep the copy.
 Right column: keep the hero blink figure. Add an A/B tag that changes in sync with the frame (cyan 'Panel A', magenta 'Panel E'), plus a Pause button (IconButton on the frame's bottom-right). Under reduced motion it is paused on A, with the button showing Play.
Home states:
 - Offline: replace the input group with a card (raised, radius 14): heading 'The engine isn't running' (20 serif), body 'Start it in a terminal, then this page connects by itself.', a code block 'paperinspector serve' with a Copy button, and a muted 'Checking again every 5 seconds…' with a spinner. Poll /api/health every 5s; on success, a toast says 'Engine connected' and the card disappears.
 - Running: the input group is replaced in place by a progress card (raised, radius 14, aria-live=polite, aria-busy=true). Title 'Inspecting 10.1371/journal.pbio.1002106' or the file name, elapsed timer 'm:ss' (tabular), and a determinate bar (6px, --mark-a, width = progress, 300ms transition). Below it, a stepper of five steps derived from the stage text by keyword (Fetch → Read pages → Find panels → Compare images → Check data, stats, text and references → Write report): done steps get a check, the current step a spinner, future steps a hollow dot. The raw stage string is shown under the stepper in 13px ink-2. There is no Cancel button, because the API has none; show 'You can leave this page; the scan keeps running.' When the job is done, route to #/run/:id.
 - Error: the progress card turns into an error card: 'The scan stopped' plus the error message (mono, 13px, max 6 lines with a Show all toggle) and the buttons [Try again] (re-submits the same input) [Start over].
Recent scans (h2 serif 20, 'Recent scans' with a count; hidden when empty and online; shows a skeleton of 3 rows while loading):
 Toolbar: search input (s32, placeholder 'Filter by title or DOI') and Segmented sort (Newest | Highest score).
 Rows (height 56, border-bottom --line, hover --raised, role=row inside role=grid; Up/Down moves between rows, Enter opens, Delete opens the delete action): ScorePill (40×24, filled with the severity colour, --on-sev text, aria-label 'Score 64, high concern'), title (serif 16, one-line ellipsis) and source/DOI below (12, ink-3), meta '3 serious · 5 to check' (13, ink-2) plus an optional 'multi-paper' chip, review progress Meter (40px, '12/31' in the tooltip), relative date ('2 h ago', title = absolute local time), and a kebab Menu: Open, Copy link, Download report, Delete.
 Delete is optimistic: the row collapses (200ms) and a toast says 'Scan deleted. Undo'. DELETE /api/runs/:id is sent only when the toast expires. On failure the row is restored and an error toast shows.
 Empty with no runs: a muted line 'Your scans will appear here.'
What it checks: keep the six cards in a 3-column grid (2 columns at ≤960px, 1 column at ≤560px). Each card has a 20px line icon, a serif 18 heading and 14px ink-2 text. Footer: version, the shortcut hint 'Press ? for keyboard shortcuts', and a link to GitHub.

====================================================================
3. RUN WORKSPACE (#/run/:id)
====================================================================
Grid: top bar 56px; body = rail | stage | inspector. Default widths: rail 320 (resizable 260-440), inspector 400 (resizable 340-560), stage flexible (min 480). Resizers are 6px hit areas with a 1px --line rule; on hover or focus the rule becomes 2px --focus; they are role=separator with aria-orientation=vertical and aria-valuenow, Left/Right move 16px, and double-click resets the width. The collapse buttons sit in each pane header and are mirrored by the [ and ] keys; a collapsed pane leaves a 40px icon strip.

3.1 Top bar (panel bg, border-bottom)
Left: logo button (aria-label 'All scans', key g h). Then a 2-line title block. Line 1: the paper title (serif 18/600, one-line ellipsis, full title in a tooltip). Line 2: a chip row (12px, ink-2, ' · ' separators, empty parts dropped): [RETRACTED badge: --critical fill, --on-sev text] Journal · 2019 · Smith et al. · doi:10.x (link, opens doi.org) · 5 figures · 42 panels · 3 tables · 2 supplementary files · 38 s. With no DOI, line 2 shows 'Uploaded file' instead of repeating the source.
Right, in order:
 - Review meter: 'Reviewed 12/31' with a 64px bar (button; click sets the Review filter to Unreviewed).
 - ScoreButton: a 40px ring (stroke 4, severity colour) with the number in the centre, plus a label 'High concern' (13/600) and 'integrity score' (12 ink-2) beside it. Click opens a Popover (raised, 320w): 'Integrity score 64 of 100'; 'Set by integrity signals only. Quality notes are not counted.'; a breakdown table Critical n · High n · Medium n · Low n; if AI-adjusted, 'Before AI review: 71'; then the verdict sentence. aria-label holds the same summary.
 - AI button (primary, fixed width 196): idle label 'Ask the AI investigator' (or 'Ask the AI again' after a review) with a sparkle icon; while running, label 'Investigating…' with a spinner, plus a 2px indeterminate bar along the bottom edge of the top bar (static 40% bar under reduced motion), the stage text in the tooltip, and an aria-live polite announcement of the stage changes. Error: Banner under the top bar, role=alert: 'The AI investigator stopped: <error>' [Open settings] [Retry] [×].
 - Export Menu (secondary, 'Export ▾'): Download HTML report, Open report in new tab, Open source PDF, Copy summary (Markdown: title, DOI, score, list of Concern and Needs-raw-data findings), Copy link to this view.
 - IconButton overflow: Settings (Cmd/Ctrl+,), Theme, Keyboard shortcuts (?).

3.2 Left rail (nav, aria-label 'Findings'; panel bg)
Tabs (WAI-ARIA, 40px tall, underline 2px ink): Findings [count] · Figures [count] · Paper · Draft. Shortcuts g f, g i (figures/images), g p, g d.
FINDINGS tab:
 - AI investigator card (only if ai_review exists): raised, radius 10, collapsible (state in localStorage). Header: 'AI investigator' and a model chip, e.g. 'claude-… · 14 steps · 82 s'. Summary at 14px, clamped to 4 lines, with 'Read more'.
 - Filter bar (sticky at the top of the list, panel bg, bottom border on scroll):
   Row 1: search input (s32, icon, placeholder 'Search findings', '/' focuses it, Esc clears and blurs); match title, CHECK_NAMES label, detail and location text.
   Row 2: Segmented Kind: All | Integrity | Quality.
   Row 3: category Chips (only categories with matches), counts computed from the current filters excluding the category filter itself.
   Row 4 (compact): Review Menu (All, Unreviewed, Concern, Needs raw data, Dismissed); 'More' menu: Show notes (N) toggle, Hide AI-dismissed toggle, Sort: Severity (default) / Figure order / Confidence.
   When any filter is active, show the line 'Showing 7 of 31 · Clear filters'.
 - List: role=listbox, aria-label 'Findings', aria-activedescendant on the list container (the list is focusable; j/k or ↓/↑ move the selection and update the stage and inspector). Groups: h2 'Integrity signals' (serif 16/600, small caption 'Could indicate manipulation. These set the score.') and h2 'Quality notes' ('Problems and missing information. Not counted in the score.'). Severity sub-headers are sticky h3s (13px/700 uppercase-free, severity colour + glyph + count, e.g. '▲ High · 3').
 - Finding row (role=option, min-height 56, padding 8 12 8 14, radius 6): 3px severity bar on the left; line 1: check name (12px, ink-2) · location chip ('Fig 3 · B ↔ E', 'Table S2 · C4:C19' or 'p. 7'; 12px mono-ish, ink-2); line 2: title (14px/1.35, 2-line clamp); line 3 (only when present): AI verdict pill ('AI: confirmed' critical tint, 'AI: likely' high tint, 'AI: unclear' neutral, 'AI: false positive' ok tint) and the review state icon on the right (○ unreviewed, ● concern in critical, ◐ needs raw data in medium, ⊘ dismissed in ink-3; aria-label on the icon). Dismissed rows keep full text contrast with the title in ink-2. Selected row: --raised background, 1px --line-strong border, shadow-1, aria-selected=true. Hover: --paper background.
 - 'Seen by the AI only' group (when observations exist): rows have a dashed left bar in ink-3 and an 'AI' glyph. They are selectable; the inspector shows them with the notice 'Not checked by a detector. Verify it yourself.'
 - Empty (filters active, no matches): 'No findings match these filters.' [Clear filters].
 - Empty (no findings at all): an illustration-free card: 'The automatic checks found nothing to flag.' 'That is not proof the paper is clean. Look through the figures yourself, or ask the AI investigator for a second opinion.' [Browse figures] [Ask the AI investigator].
 - Loading: 8 skeleton rows.
FIGURES tab: grid list of 120×80 thumbnails on a --stage background with label, page and panel count, plus a finding badge (severity colour of the worst finding, count). Toggle 'Only figures with findings'. Enter or click opens the figure in the stage (route /fig/:id) and keeps the current finding selection only if that finding is on this figure.
PAPER tab: keep the content of PaperTab.tsx, laid out as cards: 'About the paper', 'References', 'Authors and data', 'Files examined', 'How the files were found' (disclosure). Each statistic gets a status dot (ok / watch / flag, with a text label for screen readers) and, if flagged, a 'View finding →' link that selects it. Show 'Unmatched references' and 'Broken DOIs' separately. Top cited outside authors render as a small horizontal bar list (max 5). External links (PubPeer, Retraction Watch) show an ↗ icon.
DRAFT tab ('Draft comment'): an intro line, 'A starting point. Check every item yourself, and phrase each point as a question.' Below it, a checklist 'Include' of findings (default: Concern + Needs raw data, else every integrity finding at medium or above); toggling items regenerates only the lines the app inserted. Then a textarea (serif 15/1.55, autosize, min 18 rows), saved to localStorage with a 500ms debounce and a 'Saved locally' indicator (aria-live). Word count. If the generated text changes and an edit exists: Banner 'A new draft is available from the AI review.' [Use new draft] [Keep mine]. Buttons: primary 'Copy draft' (toast 'Draft copied'; on clipboard failure, select all and toast 'Press Cmd/Ctrl+C to copy'), secondary 'Open on PubPeer ↗' (pubpeer.com/search?q=<doi>), ghost 'Reset to generated' (confirmation via Popover, not confirm()). Loading: a skeleton block. Error: 'Couldn't load the draft.' [Retry].

3.3 Stage (main, aria-label 'Image stage'; --stage bg, --stage-ink text)
Stage toolbar (44px, --stage-2 bg, compact controls at 28px, --stage-line borders; on-state bg #3a4048 with white text):
 Left: Segmented Figure | Compare (key F toggles; Compare is disabled with tooltip 'Pick two panels, or select a reused-image finding' when unavailable). Then figure navigation: IconButton ‹ (key ,) · figure picker Menu ('Figure 3 ▾', listing every figure with its finding count) · IconButton › (key .) · 'p. 7' muted.
 Centre (Figure mode): view Segmented: Original 1 · Levels 2 · Reveal 3 · Noise 4 · Edges 5 · False colour 6. Each has a tooltip with a one-line explanation (Levels: 'Stretches contrast to show faint backgrounds and edits.' Reveal: 'Exaggerates tonal steps to expose pasted or painted areas.' Noise: 'Shows the noise pattern; pasted areas often have different noise.' Edges: 'Traces edges so straight splice lines stand out.' False colour: 'Maps brightness to colour to separate near-identical greys.'). While the next view loads, the old image stays and a 12px spinner shows inside the active segment; switch when it has decoded (cross-fade 120ms, instant under reduced motion).
 Right: zoom group: IconButton − (key -) · zoom % readout (button; click opens a menu Fit 0 / 50% / 100% 1 / 200% / 400%) · IconButton + (key + or =). Outlines toggle IconButton (key O; cycles Always → On hover → Off; aria-label states the current mode). Marks toggle (key M). Legend toggle (key L).
Canvas (Figure mode):
 - Viewport: overflow hidden, cursor grab; a transform scale/translate on the content (img + SVG overlay + HTML label layer). Ctrl/Cmd+wheel or trackpad pinch zooms about the pointer (10%-1600%); plain wheel pans; drag pans; holding Space switches to grab; double-click zooms ×2 about the point (Alt+double-click zooms out); keys: arrows pan 64px (Shift 256px). image-rendering: pixelated at zoom ≥200%. Fit on figure change.
 - Panel outlines: per panel a <g role=button tabindex=0 aria-label='Panel 3B. Press Enter to pick for comparison' aria-pressed>, with an outer rect stroke rgba(0,0,0,.45) 3px and an inner rect stroke rgba(255,255,255,.9) 1px (both non-scaling). Hover or focus: inner stroke #fff 1.5px plus fill rgba(18,160,196,.08). Tab order is reading order (sort by y then x). Picked first: solid 2px --mark-a with a dark halo and an 'A' tag; picked second: --mark-b with a 'B' tag. Picking a second panel opens Compare mode automatically (route /cmp/A/B). Picking a third replaces B. Esc clears picks.
 - Panel labels: an HTML layer of 11px/600 white pills on rgba(15,18,21,.72), positioned at each panel's bottom-left at constant screen size; hidden below 40% zoom when there are more than 24 panels.
 - Finding marks: rect stroke 2px in the mark colour over a 4px rgba(0,0,0,.55) halo, non-scaling; location index 0 = cyan 'A', 1 = magenta 'B', further ones alternate with numbers. Tags are HTML pills in the mark colour (A uses --mark-a-strong) at the outer top-left corner. Locations with a figure box but no panel are drawn too. When a finding is selected, smoothly fit the view to the union of its marks with 15% padding (instant under reduced motion), unless the user zoomed manually in the last 2s.
 - Legend drawer (above the filmstrip): figure label (600) and caption (serif 14/1.5), 2-line clamp; 'Show full legend' expands to at most 40% of the stage height with internal scroll.
 - Filmstrip (64px, --stage-2, horizontal scroll, scroll-snap): thumbnails 88×56 (object-fit contain) with the label under them (11px) and a finding badge (worst severity colour, count) at the top-right. Current figure: 2px white outline. role=listbox, horizontal arrow keys. Collapsible (key Shift+F); the state is remembered.
 - First-use hint (dismissible, stored in pi.hints.compare): a pill at the bottom-centre: 'Click two panels to blink them against each other.'
 - Loading: --stage-2 skeleton in the figure's aspect ratio. Image error: 'This figure couldn't be loaded.' [Retry].
 - Non-figure finding: the stage shows a centred card (stage-2, radius 14, max-width 520): an icon by category (table / text / references / record), heading 'This finding is about the <data|text|references|publication record>, not a figure.', and the location summary ('Supplementary_Data_1.xlsx · sheet “Fig2” · cells C4:C19' or 'Page 7'). Buttons: [Open file ↗] for supplements, [Open PDF at page 7 ↗] (url.source + '#page=7'), and [Browse figures].

3.4 Compare stage (Compare mode: the Blink comparator, the signature feature)
Activated by a pair finding (image.duplicate or image.duplicate_chart with 2 panels), by a manual pick of two panels, or with F. Fills the whole stage.
Toolbar (replaces the centre group): mode Segmented (radiogroup): Blink B · Swipe S · Onion N · Difference D · Side by side X. Then: A/B legend chips ('A Fig 3B' on cyan-strong, 'B Fig 3E, aligned' on magenta; clicking a chip shows that frame only). Zoom controls shared with Figure mode, with the same keys.
Frame area: centred; frames use the aligned images from url.frame(a), url.frame(b) and url.frame(diff). Default fit with 24px padding. Zoom and pan are synced across all modes, and in Side by side both panes pan together. image-rendering: pixelated at zoom ≥ 100%. A label tag at the top-left of the frame shows the frame currently visible: 'A · Fig 3B' (white on --mark-a-strong) or 'B · Fig 3E' (white on --mark-b), 12px/600, radius 4. Add a 3px frame border in the same colour, so the flicker is readable at a glance.
Modes:
 - Blink: alternates A and B at the chosen rate. Controls row (below the frame, stage-2, 44px): Play/Pause button (key P; label shows the next action), 'Flip' button (Space; pauses and toggles), rate slider 1-8 Hz, step 0.5, default 2 Hz (= 250ms per frame; 1650-rate is gone), with a readout '2 Hz' and aria-valuetext '2 flips per second'. Holding the A key shows only A and holding B shows only B ('Hold A or B to freeze a frame'). Under reduced motion: paused on A, with the note 'Auto-blink is off because reduced motion is on. Press Space to flip.'
 - Swipe: B is clipped by inset(0 0 0 split%). The handle is a 2px white line with a dark 1px halo and a 28px round grip in the middle (role=slider, aria-label 'Swipe position', aria-valuenow; Left/Right 1%, Shift+arrow 10%, Home/End 0/100). Uses pointer capture, so dragging outside the frame keeps working. Labels show at both top corners: 'A' at the left, 'B' at the right.
 - Onion: B over A with an opacity slider 0-100% (default 50; keys [ and ] are taken, so use Shift+←/→ when the slider has focus). Show both tags with their opacity.
 - Difference: computed client-side for live gain. A wrapper with isolation:isolate holds img A and img B on top with mix-blend-mode:difference; the wrapper gets filter: brightness(gain). Gain slider ×1-×16 (default ×4) and an 'Invert' toggle (white means equal). Fall back to url.frame(diff) if blending is unsupported. Caption: 'Black means the two copies agree pixel for pixel. Raise the gain to see faint differences.'
 - Side by side: two equal panes, 8px gap, synced zoom and pan, a crosshair that follows the pointer in both panes (1px white at 60%), and labels under each pane.
Measurements strip (right side of the controls row for pair findings and manual compares): 'Texture match 0.83 · 112 keypoints · mirrored · ×1.04', each with a tooltip explanation.
Manual compare results: aligned → summary line 'These panels line up: 112 keypoints agree after mirroring; texture correlates at 0.83 (copies score above 0.5, unrelated images near 0).' Not aligned → Banner (info, stage style) 'No shared content found under any shift, rotation, mirror or rescale. Showing them unaligned.' and the default mode switches to Side by side. Loading → a skeleton in the frame area with the text 'Aligning panels…' (aria-live). Error → message plus [Retry] [Clear comparison].
Exit: Esc or the 'Clear comparison' button (manual compares only) returns to Figure mode with the picks cleared; for a pair finding, F returns to Figure mode with the marks shown.

3.5 Inspector (aside, aria-label 'Finding details'; panel bg; scrolls on its own)
Header (sticky): SeverityBadge (glyph + 'High') · check name · confidence Meter (48px bar with '72%' and tooltip 'Detector confidence'). Title (serif 20/600). Location line (13, ink-2): 'Figure 3 · panels B and E' with figure buttons that jump the stage (shown when the finding spans several figures).
Action bar (sticky under the header, 40px): review Segmented with 4 options, each with a text label at ≥400px width and icon-only below it with tooltips: Unreviewed U · Concern C · Needs raw data R · Dismiss X. IconButtons: Add to draft (key A is taken in Compare, so the draft action is Shift+D), Copy link (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+C), Previous/Next (k/j). Note field: a 'Add a note' disclosure; the textarea is stored with the review state and shown in the Draft checklist.
Sections (each an h3 at 13px/700 with ink-2, collapsible with a chevron, collapse state per section in localStorage):
 1. What we found: detail text (16/1.55).
 2. Comparison (pair findings): a 160px-high Blink thumbnail that auto-blinks at 2 Hz (static under reduced motion) and a button 'Show in stage ↵'. Enter shows it in the stage if the stage is not already in Compare mode.
 3. Measurements: rows of label / value / hint icon. Texture match gets a mini bar with a tick at 0.5. Formatter: non-finite values show '–'.
 4. Evidence: images in a 1-column grid (stage bg, radius 6) with alt text built from the check and location ('Clone evidence, Figure 2C, source and copy regions outlined'). Click opens a full-screen lightbox (Esc closes, arrows step between images, zoom like the canvas). A GIF gets a Play/Pause overlay and is static under reduced motion (show the first PNG instead).
 5. Where: quotes as blockquotes (serif 15) with a 'p. 7 ↗' link to the source PDF at that page; file/sheet/cells as a list with a file-type icon and '(downloads)' hint text on supplement links.
 6. AI opinion (when f.ai is set): a card tinted by verdict: 'AI: likely' + reason.
 7. Raw data: the DataList disclosures (lists are open when there are ≤8 items, show the first 40 with 'Show all N'). Works link out with ↗.
Empty (nothing selected): 'Pick a finding, or click two panels to compare them.' plus a mini cheat-sheet: j/k next/previous · Enter compare · ? all shortcuts.

5. SETTINGS (sheet dialog, 720w, ≤ 90vh; full-screen below 640px)
====================================================================
Native <dialog> with showModal, focus moved to the first field, Esc closes, focus returns to the opener. Left navigation (180w, role=tablist, vertical) with the sections:
 AI investigator: Provider select (options read 'Anthropic (needs a key)'); Model combobox (datalist) with a helper showing the default; when the provider changes, show 'Model reset to <default>.'; Endpoint (openai-compatible kinds only); API key: a password input (its own label 'API key') plus the separate buttons Save key / Remove, and status text 'Saved on this computer' or 'Using $ENV_VAR'; switch 'This model can see images'; Effort select (anthropic only). Privacy note at the top.

====================================================================
7. ACCESSIBILITY CHECKLIST
====================================================================
- Landmarks: header, nav (rail), main (stage), aside (inspector); a skip link 'Skip to findings' as the first focusable element.
- One h1 per view (the paper title). The rail uses h2 (kind) and h3 (severity); the inspector uses h2 (title) and h3 (sections).
- Severity is never shown by colour alone: glyph plus text label everywhere.
- Every icon-only control has aria-label and a tooltip; tooltips also show on focus.
- Live regions: the job progress card, AI status, toasts, Settings 'Saved', and comparison 'Aligning…'.
- The SVG panels are focusable buttons with aria-pressed; marks are aria-hidden, and their information is repeated in the inspector's 'Where'.
- Contrast: all text ≥ 4.5:1 (≥ 3:1 for 18px+ or 14px bold); focus ring ≥ 3:1 against adjacent colours (use the --focus tokens); no opacity dimming of text.
- Reduced motion: no autoplaying blink (hero or Compare), no smooth zoom or cross-fade, a static progress bar; a hook updates live on change.
- Blink flicker safety: cap the rate at 8 Hz (well under the 3-flashes/s guideline only when the frames differ strongly; default 2 Hz; show a note at > 3 Hz: 'Fast flicker. Lower the rate if this is uncomfortable.').
- Dialogs use native <dialog> with labelled headings; menus and popovers follow the APG patterns.

====================================================================
8. COPY RULES
====================================================================
Sentence case everywhere. Neutral, question-shaped language: 'Reused image', 'Needs raw data', never 'fraud' or 'fake'. Buttons are verbs ('Inspect', 'Copy draft', 'Show in stage'). Errors say what happened, then what to do ('The engine isn't running. Start it with paperinspector serve.'). Numbers are tabular, with units ('38 s', '2 Hz', '×4'). Dates are relative in lists and absolute in tooltips. Keep the existing explanatory sentences (integrity versus quality, 'not proof the paper is clean') because they set the right tone.
